faq.q: Does owning the land automatically establish ownership of the manufactured house?
faq.a: Do not assume it does. Have the land records and manufactured-unit ownership information reviewed together before describing what can transfer.

faq.q: What does the TDHCA Statement of Ownership show?
faq.a: TDHCA describes it as evidence of ownership and liens recorded with the department. Have the actual record matched to the unit and proposed sale.

faq.q: Does an attached manufactured house automatically count as real property?
faq.a: Do not decide from its appearance. Ask the closing professional to confirm the recorded property election and any remaining requirements.

faq.q: Does Cash As-Is buy every manufactured house or arrange moving?
faq.a: No such commitment is made here. Ask whether the specific property fits our purchase criteria and confirm whether the proposal concerns the land, the unit or both.
